knowledgeBaseManifest.description: ADR 0004 - Four architectural decisions for FSP-2: full blog domain layer following client_portal precedent, Supabase pgvector as write-only boundary, Django Q2 for vectorization tasks, and draft-post access restricted to staff.
Blog bounded context component reference - domain model, layer structure, vectorization pipeline, HTTP endpoints, environment variables, and known limitations.

Developer runbook for the blog feature - adding posts via admin, applying migrations, running unit and integration tests, testing the vectorization pipeline locally, and troubleshooting common issues.
Top-level project README updated to include a Blog section describing the feature, its endpoints, semantic search capability, access control, and links to component and runbook docs.
